'''Vicca Drane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Vicca Drane worked for [[Hedrett Shipping and Investments]] as a crewmember of the ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was aboard the ship when it collided with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragement in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was left drifting in space. However, she and the rest of the crew of the ''Nerf'' were rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
